title: Inbox item DTO (P3, GET /inbox/items, GET /inbox/items/:id, POST /inbox/items, PATCH /inbox/items/:id)
description: One Inbox message addressed to ONE human, its recipient: a question an agent run asked, an approval request, an escalation mirror or a system notice — or, since v1-draft.17 (CR-15, integration inbox push), an item an integration filed from its own Inbox (`origin: integration`, e.g. Ever Gauzy's notices, questions, approvals, mentions, assignments and emails). Also the `data` of inbox.item.* events. Not a ResourceBase: an inbox item is the recipient's message, not an organization resource, so it has no owner, visibility, teams or external links. `organizationId` is null for a message outside any organization; such items are recorded for in-process listeners but never served to integrations. Fleet provenance (node names, branches, mount directories) is not exposed. Replies and state changes act as `recipientUserId` only. `origin`, `externalId`, `sourceUrl`, `sourceLabel`, `email`, `occurredAt` and `goalId` are always sent by draft.17 servers but optional here, so events recorded before draft.17 still validate.

recipientUserId.description: The human the message is for. Always set.

kind.description: question / approval / escalation / notice from Ever Works producers; an integration item may also be mention, assignment, email or other (never escalation).

origin.description: platform = filed by an Ever Works producer; integration = filed by an integration key through POST /inbox/items (CR-15).

externalId.description: The integration's own id of an integration item (unique per tenant and integration key); null for platform items.

integrationKeyId.description: The integration key that filed an integration item (compare with whoami.keyId to tell your own items from another integration's); null for platform items.

sourceUrl.description: The item in the integration's own app (https only); null for platform items.

sourceLabel.description: The badge text of an integration item (defaults to the integration's name, e.g. "Ever Gauzy"); null for platform items.

email.description: The header block of a kind email integration item; null otherwise.

occurredAt.description: When it happened at the source, as the integration said (integration items only).

goalId.description: The Goal an integration item is about (related.goalId).

options.description: Structured answer buttons (question / approval items); null = free-text reply only.

sourceType.description: Which producer filed it. Open set; consumers must accept unknown values.

InboxItemEmail.description: Plain text; rendered as text, never as markup.

id.description: Stable token sent back as the reply's optionId.
